<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.08"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="21" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">9:41</text>
    <line x1="321" y1="18" x2="321" y2="14" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="326" y1="18" x2="326" y2="12" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="18" x2="331" y2="10" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="348" cy="15" r="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <path d="M342 14 Q348 7 354 14" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <rect x="362" y="9" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="365" y="12" width="15" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#050505"/>
    <rect x="385" y="13" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#050505"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Decorative header accent -->
  <circle cx="347" cy="93" r="42" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
  <circle cx="363" cy="78" r="24" fill="#1877F2" opacity="0.12"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="118" r="5" fill="#1877F2"/>
  <circle cx="51" cy="118" r="5" fill="#A0A3BD"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="118" r="5" fill="#A0A3BD"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <text x="24" y="161" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="32px" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">Create Account</text>
  <text x="24" y="190" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#4E4B66">Join the community and stay informed.</text>

  <!-- Username field -->
  <text x="24" y="222" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">Username</text>
  <rect x="23" y="232" width="343" height="49" rx="6" fill="#000000" opacity="0.05"/>
  <rect x="24" y="231" width="343" height="49" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="255" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="43" cy="269" rx="11" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="64" y="262" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#A0A3BD">Enter your username</text>

  <!-- Password field -->
  <text x="24" y="316" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">Password</text>
  <rect x="23" y="326" width="343" height="49" rx="6" fill="#000000" opacity="0.05"/>
  <rect x="24" y="325" width="343" height="49" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="37" y="344" width="13" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M40 344 Q40 337 43.5 337 Q47 337 47 344" fill="none" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="43.5" cy="349" r="1.5" fill="#A0A3BD"/>
  <text x="64" y="356" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#A0A3BD">Create a strong password</text>
  <circle cx="345" cy="348" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="339" y1="348" x2="351" y2="348" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="345" cy="348" r="2" fill="#A0A3BD"/>

  <!-- Remember row -->
  <rect x="24" y="397" width="18" height="18" rx="3" fill="#1877F2"/>
  <polyline points="28,406 32,410 39,402" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="51" y="411" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#4E4B66">Remember me</text>
  <text x="267" y="411" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#1877F2">Password tips</text>

  <!-- Primary button -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="440" width="343" height="50" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="195.5" y="471" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#FFFFFF">Create account</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Divider -->
  <line x1="24" y1="520" x2="166" y2="520" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="224" y1="520" x2="366" y2="520" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="195" y="525" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#A0A3BD">or continue with</text>

  <!-- Social buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="545" width="164" height="48" rx="6" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
    <circle cx="49" cy="569" r="10" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="49" y="575" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">f</text>
    <text x="116" y="575" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#667080">Facebook</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="202" y="545" width="164" height="48" rx="6" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
    <circle cx="227" cy="569" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D7D9DE" stroke-width="1"/>
    <path d="M227 559 A10 10 0 0 1 236 564" fill="none" stroke="#4285F4" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M236 564 A10 10 0 0 1 234 576" fill="none" stroke="#34A853" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M234 576 A10 10 0 0 1 219 574" fill="none" stroke="#FBBC05" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M219 574 A10 10 0 0 1 221 562" fill="none" stroke="#EB4335" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="290" y="575" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#667080">Google</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Account prompt -->
  <text x="127" y="647" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#4E4B66">Already have an account?</text>
  <text x="137" y="647" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#1877F2">Log in</text>
  <line x1="137" y1="650" x2="181" y2="650" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Trust note -->
  <circle cx="31" cy="688" r="8" fill="#00BA88" opacity="0.14"/>
  <polyline points="27,688 30,691 35,685" fill="none" stroke="#00BA88" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="48" y="693" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#4E4B66">Your information is kept private and secure.</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="747" width="390" height="97" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="43,780 54,771 65,780 65,793 57,793 57,784 51,784 51,793 43,793" fill="#A0A3BD"/>
    <text x="54" y="814" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#A0A3BD">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="132" cy="781" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="138" y1="788" x2="145" y2="795" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="132" y="814" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#A0A3BD">Explore</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="202" y="772" width="15" height="19" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="205,777 214,777" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="205,782 214,782" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="210" y="814" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#A0A3BD">Saved</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="309" cy="778" r="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <ellipse cx="309" cy="791" rx="11" ry="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="309" y="814" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#1877F2">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
